apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: notification-deployment
  namespace: core-qa
  labels:
    app: notification
    team: media-streaming
    env: qa
  annotations:
    deployment.kubernetes.io/revision-history-limit: "5"
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: notification
      team: media-streaming
      env: qa
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: notification
        team: media-streaming
        env: qa
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: notification-container
        image: my-docker-repo/notification-go:v1.2.3
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        env:
        - name: GOMAXPROCS
          value: "4"
        - name: LOG_LEVEL
          value: "info"
        - name: HTTP_TIMEOUT
          value: "5s"
        - name: GO_ENV
          value: "production"
        - name: METRICS_PORT
          value: "9090"
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: "100m"
            memory: "256Mi"
          requests:
            cpu: "50m"
            memory: "128Mi"

kind: ClusterRoleBinding
metadata:

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: recommendation
  namespace: fintech-staging
  labels:
    app: recommendation
    team: fintech-team
    env: staging
spec:
  serviceName: "recommendation"
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: recommendation
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: recommendation
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: recommendation
        image: fintech/recommendation-service:v1.2.3
        env:
        - name: JAVA_OPTS
          value: "-Xmx512m"
        - name: SPRING_PROFILES_ACTIVE
          value: "staging"
        - name: DB_POOL_SIZE
          value: "10"
        - name: JVM_HEAP_MAX
          value: "512m"
        - name: MANAGEMENT_SERVER_PORT
          value: "8081"
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8081
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /opt/recommendation/data
          name: data
      volumes:
      - name: data
        emptyDir: {}

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: auth-reporting-dev
  namespace: auth-reporting-dev
  labels:
    app: auth-reporting
    team: backend
    env: dev
  annotations:
    sidecar.istio.io/inject: "false"
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: auth-reporting
      team: backend
      env: dev
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: auth-reporting
        team: backend
        env: dev
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: auth-reporting
          image: mycompany/auth-reporting:1.0.2
          ports:
            - containerPort: 80
          env:
            - name: ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT
              value: Development
            - name: DOTNET_RUNNING_IN_CONTAINER
              value: "true"
            - name: Logging__LogLevel__Default
              value: Information
            - name: ASPNETCORE_URLS
              value: "http://+:80"
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 1Gi
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 512Mi
          securityContext:
            runAsUser: 1000
            runAsGroup: 3000
            fsGroup: 27
      initContainers:
        - name: init-auth-reporting
          image: mycompany/auth-reporting-init:1.0.2
          command: ["sh", "-c", "sleep 5 && echo 'Initialization completed.'"]
      tolerations:
        - key: "dedicated"
          operator: "Equal"
          value: "dev"
          effect: "NoSchedule"

  name: enrollment-staging
  namespace: enrollment-staging
  labels:
    app: enrollment
    team: media-team
    env: staging
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: enrollment
      team: media-team
      env: staging
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: enrollment
        team: media-team
        env: staging
      annotations:
        description: "DaemonSet for the enrollment service in staging environment"
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: enrollment-staging
        image: mycompany/enrollment-go:v1.2.3
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: "500m"
            memory: "512Mi"
          requests:
            cpu: "250m"
            memory: "256Mi"
        env:
        - name: GOMAXPROCS
          value: "2"
        - name: LOG_LEVEL
          value: "info"
        - name: HTTP_TIMEOUT
          value: "30s"
        - name: GO_ENV
          value: "staging"
        - name: METRICS_PORT
          value: "8080"
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        volumeMounts:
        - name: config-volume
          mountPath: /etc/config
      volumes:
      - name: config-volume
        configMap:
          name: enrollment-config

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: sre-inventory-billing
  namespace: telecom-prod
spec:
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: sre-inventory-billing
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: sre-inventory-billing
          image: my-repo/sre-inventory-billing:v1.2.3
          env:
            - name: NODE_ENV
              value: production
            - name: PORT
              value: "3000"
            - name: NPM_CONFIG_LOGLEVEL
              value: info
            - name: SESSION_TIMEOUT
              value: "3600"
            - name: LOG_FORMAT
              value: json
          ports:
            - containerPort: 3000
          resources:
            requests:
              memory: "512Mi"
              cpu: "250m"
            limits:
              memory: "1Gi"
              cpu: "500m"

        runAsGroup: 3000
        fsGroup: 27

      hostNetwork: false
      hostPID: false
      hostIPC: false

        - name: config-volume
          configMap:
            name: sre-inventory-billing-config
      annotations:
        scheduler.alpha.kubernetes.io/tolerations: |
          [
            {
              "key": "dedicated",
              "operator": "Equal",
              "value": "sre-inventory-billing",
              "effect": "NoSchedule"
            }
          ]

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: claims-gateway-dev
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: claims-gateway
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: claims-gateway
        image: myregistry.com/energy/claims-gateway-python:v1.2.3
        env:
        - name: PYTHONUNBUFFERED
          value: "true"
        - name: DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE
          value: "settings.dev"
        - name: GUNICORN_WORKERS
          value: "4"
        - name: FLASK_ENV
          value: "development"
        - name: WORKERS_PER_CORE
          value: "1"
        ports:
        - containerPort: 5000
      securityContext:
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 3000
        fsGroup: 27
        readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
      volumes:
      - name: config-volume
        secret:
          secretName: claims-gateway-config-dev
      initContainers:
      - name: init-ssl-certs
        image: myregistry.com/energy/openssl:v1.1.1k
        command: ["sh", "-c"]
        args:
        - openssl req -newkey rsa:4096 -nodes -keyout /etc/nginx/ssl/key.pem -out /etc/nginx/ssl/cert.pem -subj "/CN=claims-gateway-dev"
        volumeMounts:
        - name: ssl-certs
          mountPath: /etc/nginx/ssl
      volumes:
      - name: ssl-certs
        emptyDir: {}
    serviceAccountName: claims-gateway-sa

    app: recommendation-checkout
    team: fintech
    env: qa
    version: v1.0.2
  annotations:
    description: "Deployment for the recommendation checkout service in the QA environment"
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: recommendation-checkout
      version: v1.0.2
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: recommendation-checkout
        team: fintech
        env: qa
        version: v1.0.2
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: recommendation-checkout
        image: my-docker-registry/fintech/recommendation-checkout:v1.0.2
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8000
        env:
        - name: PYTHONUNBUFFERED
          value: "true"
        - name: DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE
          value: "myproject.settings.qa"
        - name: GUNICORN_WORKERS
          value: "4"
        - name: FLASK_ENV
          value: "development"
        - name: WORKERS_PER_CORE
          valueFrom:
            resourceFieldRef:
              containerName: recommendation-checkout
              resource: cpu
              divisor: 1024
      imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
      securityContext:
        runAsUser: 1001
        fsGroup: 2000
      volumes:
      - name: config-volume
        configMap:
          name: recommendation-checkout-config
      - name: secrets-volume
        secret:
          secretName: recommendation-checkout-secrets
      affinity:
        podAntiAffinity:
          preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution:
          - weight: 100
            podAffinityTerm:
              labelSelector:
                matchExpressions:
                - key: app
                  operator: In
                  values:
                  - recommendation-checkout
              topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname
      nodeSelector:
        kubernetes.io/os: linux

    env: production
    purpose: batch-processing

      labels:
        app: ledgerNotification
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: ledgerNotification
